SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.......
S.1, Special Branch Station.
REPORT
Date...Nov....22,.....1937.

Subject Ministry of Communications Radio Broadcasting Station
- broadcasts national salvation songs.
Made by Clerk Wong Chih-tsing Forwarded by S. Crawford

Between 5.45 p.m. and 6.30 p.m. November 20, 1937,
the Radio Broadcasting Station of the Ministry of
Communications (1,300 k.c.), Sassoon House, broadcasted
the following national salvation songs :-
1. Little Army (小軍人) (Not objectionable)
2. Youth's Marching Song (青年進行曲) (Not objectionable)
3. Youngster's Marching Song (少年進行曲) -do-
4. Hot Blood (熱血) -do-
5. Rise Up Unanimously (一致奮起) (words not available)
6. Happy People (快樂的人民) (Not objectionable)
7. God of Liberty (自由神) -do-
8. Chinese Race Will Not be Ruined (中華民族不為亡)
(Not objectionable)
9. March of the Mother Country (祖國進行曲)
(Not objectionable)
10. Down with Tung Yang (Japan) (打倒東洋)
Translation: Down with Japan, down with Japan.
Kill traitors, kill traitors.
Let all the people of the nation
rise up and save China.
11. August 13 War Song (八一三戰歌) (words not available).
12. Defend National Territory (保衛國土).
Translation of Extracts:
Brethren, Rise up! Defend the National Territory.
Launch a counter-attack upon the enemy.
See the Japanese have commenced operations.
Listen to the guns of the aggressors; they are
roaring.
To retreat means death. The only way to live
is resistance.
The songs were sung by members of a Shanghai
Municipality Chorus Group (上海市歌唱社), of which
the Special Branch has no record.
Wong Chih Tsing
Clerk.
D. C. (Special Branch)

（左侧批注：）
CP.
Under consideration
I suggest 15
to close
down.
RB.
20 Nov 1937

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号.......
S.1，特务科分站。
报告
日期...1937年11月....22日.....

主题 交通部广播电台
- 播送救亡歌曲。
由书记员黄志清（Wong Chih-tsing）撰写 由 S. Crawford 转呈

1937年11月20日下午5时45分至6时30分之间，
位于沙逊大厦的交通部广播电台（频率1,300千周）播送了
以下救亡歌曲：-
1. 《小军人》（无不当之处）
2. 《青年进行曲》（无不当之处）
3. 《少年进行曲》 -同上-
4. 《热血》 -同上-
5. 《一致奋起》（歌词未获）
6. 《快乐的人民》（无不当之处）
7. 《自由神》 -同上-
8. 《中华民族不为亡》
（无不当之处）
9. 《祖国进行曲》
（无不当之处）
10. 《打倒东洋》
译文：打倒日本，打倒日本。
杀汉奸，杀汉奸。
让全国同胞
奋起救中国。
11. 《八一三战歌》（歌词未获）。
12. 《保卫国土》。
节选译文：
同胞们，起来！保卫国土。
向敌人发起反攻。
看哪，日军已开始行动。
听那侵略者的枪炮声；它们在
咆哮。
后退即意味着死亡。生存的唯一途径
是抵抗。
这些歌曲由上海市歌唱社成员演唱，
特务科并无该团体的记录。
黄志清
书记员。
副总监（特务科）

（左侧批注：）
CP.
正在审议
我建议罚款15元
并勒令其
关闭。
RB.
1937年11月20日
22/11

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S.I, Special Branch...........xxxxx,
REPORT
Date November 15, 1937.

Subject (in full) Radio station of the Ministry of Communication(s - warned
against broadcasting propaganda songs and lectures.

Made by....D.S. Lockwood................Forwarded by C Crawford W.J

Acting on the instructions of the Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch), D.S. Lockwood and D.S.I. Shih Sau-chien,
at 10.30 a.m. November 15, 1937 interviewed Dr. P.H.Wang
(王葆和), officer in charge of the Radio Station operated
by the Ministry of Communication(s in Sasson House, Nanking
Road. Dr. P.H. Wang was advised not to permit the
broadcasting of propaganda songs and lectures over the
system. In reply, he stated that the matter would be
referred to the Ministry of Communication(s and that pending
receipt of a reply he would take every precaution against
broadcasting any programme which would be considered
objectionable by the Municipal Police.

C.P.
If they don't comply I think a fine    L.S. Lockwood
line will be necessary.                 D. S.
（印：15 NOV 1937）
D.C. (Special Branch).

S.I.
See annex to this.
DSL    C.    mB
（印：16 NOV 1937）

主题（全称） 交通部电台 - 被警告不得播送宣传性歌曲及讲座。

由....D.S. Lockwood 撰写................由 C Crawford W.J 转呈

遵照副总监（特务科）的指示，D.S. Lockwood 和警司石守坚（Shih Sau-chien）于1937年11月15日上午10时30分会见了王葆和博士（Dr. P.H.Wang），他是负责南京路沙逊大厦内由交通部运营的电台的负责人。已劝告王葆和博士不要允许通过该系统播送宣传性歌曲和讲座。作为回应，他表示此事将呈报交通部，在收到回复之前，他将采取一切预防措施，避免播送任何可能被工部局警务处视为不当的节目。

C.P.
如果他们不遵守，我认为有必要    L.S. Lockwood
处以罚款。                 D. S.
（印：1937年11月15日）
副总监（特务科）。

S.I.
见本件附件。
DSL    C.    mB
（印：1937年11月16日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
S.1, Special Branch, XXXX
REPORT
Date November 1, 37.

Subject Lecture on Sino-Japanese Hostilities in Shanghai - broadcast
through radio station of the Ministry of Communications

Made by Clerk Loh Wei-kong Forwarded by C. [Signature]

Between 4.30 p.m. and 5 p.m., October 29, Mr. Dao
Pah-chuen (陶百川), member of the Standing Committee of
the local Tangpu, delivered a speech, through the broadcasting
station of the Ministry of Communications (K.C.1,300), on the
subject "What Shall We Do For the Defence of Shanghai?"
The following is a brief account of his speech :
"After gallant resistance against the Japanese
military, air and naval forces for a period of two and
half months, our troops temporarily withdrew from the
Chapei area for strategic reasons. As a result, numbers
of local Chinese residents appear to have been misled by
the rumour that Greater Shanghai had been abandoned.
The people, however, should understand that Shanghai is
the economic centre of China, and we must hold on to it.
Kiangwan and Chapei are but temporarily in the hands of
the enemy. Our brave soldiers are still in Pootung and
Western Chapei, where they continue to fight for the
defence of Shanghai.
"In order to save the nation, we must act on the
following lines :
1. All Chinese should be firm during the present campaign
against the Japanese imperialists. The prevailing fight
is a life and death struggle of the Chinese race, and
consequently we must unite together in the face of the
enemy.
2. We should continue to encourage our fighters in the
front, in order to secure final victory. The temporary
occupation of Chapei and Kiangwan by the Japanese will
not shake our determination to resist the enemy.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE - 1 NOV 1937）
（批：file J.B.）

S.1，特务科，XXXX
报告
日期 1937年11月1日。

主题 关于上海中日敌对行动的讲座 - 通过
交通部广播电台播送

由书记员罗伟康（Loh Wei-kong）撰写 由 C. [签名] 转呈

10月29日下午4时30分至5时之间，当地党部
常务委员会委员陶百川先生（Mr. Dao Pah-chuen），通过
交通部广播电台（频率1,300千周）发表了题为“我们该如何
保卫上海？”的演讲。
以下是其演讲概要：
“在对日本海陆空军英勇抵抗了两个半月
之后，我军出于战略原因暂时撤出闸北地区。因此，
许多当地中国居民似乎被大上海已被放弃的谣言所
误导。然而，民众应当明白，上海是中国的经济中心，
我们必须坚守。江湾和闸北只是暂时落入敌手。
我英勇的士兵仍在浦东和闸北西部，他们继续为
保卫上海而战。
“为了拯救国家，我们必须按以下方针行事：
1. 所有中国人在当前对抗日本帝国主义的战役中
必须坚定。目前的战斗是中华民族生死存亡的斗争，
因此我们在面对敌人时必须团结一致。
2. 我们应继续鼓励前线的战士，以确保最终胜利。
日军暂时占领闸北和江湾不会动摇我们要抵抗敌人的
决心。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 - 1937年11月1日）
（批：归档 J.B.）

3. Chinese citizens should contribute as much as
possible for the comfort of our soldiers. Our
warriors have been fighting gallantly against the
enemy, and it is incumbent upon every Chinese to
sacrifice himself for the sake of the nation.
4. We, the Chinese in Shanghai, must organize ourselves
to serve the nation. During this critical stage, we
should refrain from serving the enemy who would make of
us tools by which they could successfully counteract
the effect of our resistance. Moreover, we should
prevent our brethren from conducting activities to the
detriment of our nation. For this purpose, we must
organize national salvation bodies or join other
organizations of a similar nature."

3. 中国公民应尽最大可能捐款捐物以慰劳
我军将士。我们的战士一直在英勇抗敌，每个
中国人都有责任为国家牺牲自己。
4. 我们上海的中国人必须组织起来为国效力。
在这个危急关头，我们应避免为敌人服务，以免
成为他们用来成功抵消我们抵抗效果的工具。
此外，我们应防止我们的同胞从事损害国家的
活动。为此，我们必须组织救亡团体或加入其他
类似性质的组织。”

D.B.K.
